source_refs.note: 4. Sympatric Speciation: a main subheading of 1.8 Species and speciation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 33-33.

blocks.text: Is mein nayi species usi zameeni ilaqe ke andar, bina kisi physical rukawat ke, banti hain. Sympatric speciation aksar polyploidy (jab jandar mein chromosomes ke kai sets hon) ya niche differentiation (jab ek aabadi ke mukhtalif hisse mukhtalif resources istemal karne lagein) se hoti hai. Misal: kuch poday polyploidy se guzarte hain, jis se fauran reproductive isolation ho jati hai aur nayi species ban jati hai.

items: Species: aise afraad ka group jo qudrat mein aapas mein interbreed kar ke fertile aulad paida karte hain; Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation ko asal kasauti banaya.
Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain, isi liye sirf shakal dhoka de sakti hai.
Speciation: saanjhe buzurg se nayi species ka banna, genetic tabdeeliyon ke jama hone se jo reproductive isolation paida karti hain.
Allopatric: zameeni rukawat. Peripatric: kinare ki chhoti aabadi. Parapatric: gradient par saath wale mahol. Sympatric: ek hi ilaqa, polyploidy ya niche differentiation se.

blocks.prompt: Ek pode ki do aabadiyan tezaabi aur alkaline mitti par saath saath ugti hain aur ab aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Yeh speciation ka kaun sa tareeqa hai, aur yeh sympatric speciation se kaise alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Parapatric speciation: aabadiyan mitti ke gradient par saath saath hain aur gene flow kam hai, jaise Anthoxanthum odoratum mein. Sympatric speciation mein nayi species usi ek ilaqe ke andar banti hai, bina kisi alag mahol ya rukawat ke, maslan polyploidy se.
